title: I like playing casual mobile fake money casino games but didn't like ending 0 and forced to pay for coins or watch ads so i built one
author: Ill-Papaya1182
selftext:
The process of creating it is so fun and so does playing it, never imagined that i will be able to build a fraction of this and it only costed me $26 to make. It's pretty close to some mobile games i played and it still have so much room to improve

It's 100 percent free, no ads, no payment, made just for fun and not a commercial game

Tools used:  
Claude code  
ChatGPT

I just vibecoded it using claudecode then generated some images from chatgpt
